categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Validation' label and modifies chainstate IBD block-connection logic, UTXO flushing, and AssumeUTXO verification.
categories.rationale: Validates developer-provided AssumeUTXO commitments against the UTXO set reconstructed during regular IBD to provide decentralized verification of snapshot hashes. The PR description notes that while nodes reconstruct the UTXO set during IBD, they 'never verify their reconstructed UTXO set against the hardcoded commitment.' This adds a useful defense-in-depth check for hardcoded constants without fixing an active defect or altering consensus rules, making review worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.
